whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm conan.lock no longer carries a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
